children: Soluna energizeed final 14 MW at Kati 1, completing 83 MW site and securing conditional Base Load classification for full 166 MW Kati campus.
Final 14 MW at Project Kati 1 energized on time, completing the 83 MW first phase and raising operating capacity to ~206 MW.
ERCOT conditionally classified the full 166 MW Kati campus, including planned Kati 2 AI expansion, as Base Load in Batch Zero.
Base Load status preserves interconnection capacity and avoids further reliability evaluation or megawatt allocation in Batch Zero.
Classification is conditional pending ERCOT verification; Soluna is participating and expects confirmation of the full 166 MW.
Kati 1 delivered on schedule and on budget; Kati 2 will add 83 MW for AI and high-performance computing behind the meter.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Soluna finishes Kati 1, energizes final 14 MW and secures conditional 166 MW Base Load in ERCOT
